components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Reading Rose filled button for the main commit action (e.g. modal "Continue").
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e11d48; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #be123c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fecdd3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for an alternate action (e.g. "Sign in with Google").
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1f2937; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fecdd3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No-fill text button for a low-emphasis action (e.g. "Forgot your password?", modal "Cancel").
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #4b5563; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Role switch (User / Admin) on the login page: a gray track with a white active pill.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; background: #f3f4f6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px; gap: 4px; } .ds-segmented-item { flex: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; background: transparent; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.2s; } .ds-segmented-item--active { background: #ffffff; color: #111827; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled text field with a rose focus ring and a red error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #374151; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #171717; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-field-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fecdd3; } .ds-field-input.error { border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-field-input.error:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fca5a5; }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: The floating container that holds the login form — the only card-level surface in the current implementation.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px 0 hsla(220,30%,5%,0.05), 0 15px 35px -5px hsla(220,25%,10%,0.05); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky site header: logo left, horizontal nav tabs right, on Chula Pink.
components.html: HomeLogin
components.css: .ds-topmenu { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 64px; background: #f472b6; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-topmenu-logo { width: 48px; margin: 8px 16px 8px 0; } .ds-topmenu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 150px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-topmenu-item:hover { background: #f9a8d4; } .ds-topmenu-item--active { background: #fff1f2; color: #be123c; }

components.name: Hero Banner
components.description: Full-bleed image with a dark scrim and centered white content — the home page hero.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 500px; overflow: hidden; background: #9ca3af center/cover; } .ds-hero-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-hero-title { position: relative; display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

narrative.overview:
CULibSpace's baseline mood is calm and utilitarian: this is a library first, and the interface should read as quiet, efficient, and operate-mode by default — minimal decoration, few flourishes, a task done without ceremony. Chula pink is the room's single accent, never the room itself: it marks brand chrome (the header) and interactive commitment (buttons, links), while the space around it stays white and unshowy.

But a reading room isn't silent everywhere, all the time — the second floor during exam season is a different room than the same floor on a quiet Tuesday. The system should be able to express real activity honestly (a near-full zone, a busy time slot) without abandoning its calm baseline or reaching for colors outside the pink/rose family to do it. Density and occupancy are content, not decoration; when future work builds zone/table availability views, let saturation, fill, or count — not new hues — carry that energy.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, utilitarian baseline; brand color is rationed, not ambient
Flat by default — shadow is reserved for surfaces that genuinely float (card, modal)
Two-tier corner language: small on controls, generous on containers
Room to express "busy" states honestly later, without breaking the palette

rules.name: The One Brand Color Rule
rules.body: Chula Pink appears once, as header chrome, at full saturation, and nowhere else. Everything that needs to look "pink" for an interactive reason (a button, a link, a focus ring) uses Reading Rose instead — the two never substitute for each other.

rules.name: The Floating-Surface-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow appears only on a card or modal that sits above the page plane. Buttons, inputs, and chrome stay flat; don't add hover-lift shadows to controls without a deliberate decision to expand the vocabulary.

dos: Do keep Chula Pink to brand chrome only (header) and Reading Rose to everything interactive (buttons, links, focus) — the One Brand Color Rule.
Do use the two-tier radius scale: rounded-md (6px) for controls, rounded-xl (12px) for containers.
Do keep shadow rare — only a genuinely floating surface (card, modal) gets one.
Do let future occupancy/density UI (zone and table availability) express "busy" honestly through saturation, fill, or count rather than new hues outside the pink/rose family.
Do use Geist Sans (via var(--font-sans)) as the UI typeface — not Arial, Helvetica, or another platform-default sans.
donts: Don't treat the current pink-400 / rose-600 hex values as final brand color. They're straight Tailwind defaults and have been flagged as reading too saturated/"hot pink" for true Chula pink — revisit against a real brand reference in a future /impeccable colorize or /impeccable craft pass rather than treating them as locked.

Don't extend the login page's blue-tinted radial gradient (hsl(210,100%,97%) → white) sitting under the pink-100 background — it reads as a mismatched leftover (likely copied from a template), not a deliberate two-tone effect.

Don't treat the prefers-color-scheme: dark background swap to #eed9df as a designed dark theme — it's an open, undecided placeholder; a real dark mode needs deliberate design work later, not silent extension of this value.
Don't use a full-page pink background or the Inter font — a binding project-wide rule from the repo root CLAUDE.md.
